layout_rules: The featured comment uses a 1536px wide true AMOLED black canvas with a smoked charcoal surface.
A restrained warm yellow haze, fine illuminated edge, and soft shadows provide depth without washing out the black background.
Header includes ModGlow icon and name, moderator badge, timestamp, and pinned marker.
Comment text uses 64px IBM Plex Sans with 82px line height, larger than typical Reddit comment text.
Bold, italic, and bold italic Markdown runs are retained in the SVG.
The card grows vertically with wrapped text and keeps 112px of bottom breathing room.
SVG text is escaped and oversized content is rejected rather than clipped.
Promo panels remain marketing artwork, not screenshots of a live app.
note: AMOLED black and warm neon yellow smoked glass visual system. Renderer is the source of truth for actual output dimensions.
